# Recreation Prompt

Recreate VaultStream 2299 as a deterministic, browser-native merge/drop puzzle. Preserve a five-column by seven-row board, next-piece preview, column tap input, same-tier orthogonal merging, gravity settling, clout scoring, blocked-column feedback, board-full failure, and restart. Present the world as a future wasteland vault broadcast starring a live influencer avatar. Use amber, rust, rad-green, and neon-cyan retro-future UI, procedural skyline/scanline/reactor visuals, compact mobile HUD, catalog-approved sci-fi audio, and approved compact reaction GIF feedback without changing the core puzzle rules.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: mobile-friendly merge / match puzzle board game.
- objective: place incoming tokens into columns, create adjacent same-tier matches, merge upward, score points, and keep the grid from filling.
- input model: tap/click a board column, press 1-5 for columns, use space/enter or the drop CTA for the center column, restart with button or R.
- core loop: preview next token, choose a column, token drops to the lowest empty slot, adjacent matching tokens merge into a higher tier, score increases, gravity settles the board, repeat until capped.
- fail/friction state: a full column rejects input; a full top row ends the run and exposes a restart path.

## Protected mechanics
- Five-column, seven-row vertical board readability.
- Deterministic next-token generation and drop-to-lowest-empty-cell behavior.
- Orthogonal same-tier adjacency merge with gravity and scoring feedback.
- Board-cap loss state, restart, score, best-score, and mobile tap actionability.

## Remixed target
VaultStream 2299 reframes the merge puzzle as a futuristic Fallout-inspired wasteland broadcast. The focal actor is a live-streaming vault influencer dropping sponsor signals into a reactor grid. Matching signal tiers merge into bigger clout moments, while failure means the feed overloads before orbital fame.
